text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from *Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth* (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's shift got through fine. The same note has a follow-up to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from *Moss: North cheat sheet* (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md, undated). Thea logged it because gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags during third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware.

Moss's other notes mention QFL, including the 9/14 pipeline digest and the 3/23/2026 renewal check-in, but neither has a ticket number. The cheat sheet also mentions Quarendon Freightways, a separate company and not a customer. None of the tickets in the Central notes (#4409, #4412, FR-882) are QFL's. I only checked Moss's shared notes, not any channels.
